method: Actual Next.js standalone production server, E2E authentication, real insights HTTP route and signed duel host. RSS sampled through loopback Node inspector.
limitations: Uses loopback HTTP and synthetic E2E authentication; excludes browser rendering, Clerk network calls and TLS. Separate service timing is not instrumented.
RSS is actual process.memoryUsage().rss after 3 forced GCs; allocator retention and concurrent machine load affect results.
Engine files and source catalog are read-only; Next authentication uses its own disposable database backup. Benchmark decks are derived legal 60-card inputs.
Scope preparation is recorded separately; first suggestion timing is cold for the web service with the legality host already warm.

scenarios.derivation: Canonical published Main Deck cards filtered through authoritative admission; duplicate source cards up to copy limits, then admitted catalog Main Deck cards until 60; retained admitted source Extra Deck cards; empty Side Deck.
